title: Bootstrap the TypeScript project
details: Set up the library, CLI entry point, build, type checks, and test runner.
acceptance_criteria: A clean checkout builds and runs tests with documented commands.
The CLI imports the library; module boundaries allow independent adapters.

title: Define core records and validation schemas
details: Define JSON Schema draft 2020-12 schemas and TypeScript types, including every supporting type named in the specification.
acceptance_criteria: Identifiers, names, timestamps, units, status values, and version fields are validated.
All public requests, results, manifests, recipes, events, and bundles round-trip through JSON.
Invalid inputs produce field-specific errors before side effects.

title: Implement structured errors and compatibility rules
details: Implement error codes, retry classifications, version checks, and extension handling.
acceptance_criteria: Every required error code has a stable serializable representation.
Unknown descriptive extensions are tolerated; unknown requirements and required extensions are rejected.
Errors exclude credentials and distinguish policy, input, semantic, and provider failures.

title: Implement the durable control store
details: Add a local transactional database, migrations, durable records, and atomic compare-and-swap operations.
acceptance_criteria: Concurrent processes share uniqueness and transaction guarantees.
Restart preserves sessions, attachments, operations, transitions, and cleanup records.
Missing or unverified blobs cannot become committed revision references.

title: Implement mutation leases and fencing
details: Serialize attachment mutations with durable leases and monotonic fencing tokens.
acceptance_criteria: An expired controller cannot commit after a newer controller acquires authority.
Release and replacement use the same mutation lock.
Tests race controllers and deliver delayed provider responses after lease expiration.

title: Implement the durable event stream
details: Write events with state mutations and expose replay by session sequence.
acceptance_criteria: All required event types have validated payloads.
State and its event commit together; restart preserves sequence order.
Consumers can resume and tolerate duplicate delivery without missing committed events.

title: Implement session creation and inspection
details: Create durable session identities and describe their workspace, policy, attachments, and resources.
acceptance_criteria: Attachment names are unique within each session.
Inspection reports actual persisted state without claiming harness restoration.
Public create and describe results satisfy their schemas.

title: Implement trusted policy evaluation
details: Accept authenticated authority from the embedding context and enforce all version-one policy dimensions.
acceptance_criteria: Check provider, operation, locality, transfer, egress, host access, lifetime, resources, secrets, and service audience limits.
Model-controlled inputs cannot replace authenticated authority.
Omitted permissions inherit configured limits and preferences never weaken them.

title: Implement secret reference resolution
details: Resolve authorized secret references at use time and keep credentials out of public metadata.
acceptance_criteria: Resolution rejects unauthorized references and uses current authority.
Resource serialization, events, errors, and bundles omit reusable credentials.
Raw artifact and file storage follows configured access and export policy.

title: Implement capability discovery and matching
details: Validate descriptors and match semantic requirements against configured environment offers.
acceptance_criteria: Explicit provider selection works; zero and multiple matches produce the specified errors.
Platform, resource minima, engine semantics, and constraints are checked without silent fallback.
Acquired manifests undergo the same validation before activation.

title: Define adapter contracts and a deterministic test adapter
details: Implement adapter interfaces and a controllable fake for allocation, operation, lease, and failure behavior.
acceptance_criteria: All supporting acquisition, cancellation, binding, and lease types are concrete.
The fake simulates lost responses, delayed completion, expiration, and release failure.
Tests require no external accounts or paid allocations.

title: Implement durable acquisition and reconciliation
details: Persist acquisition identities, validate acquired environments, and activate attachments.
acceptance_criteria: Duplicate requests recover the same logical acquisition or reject conflicting inputs.
A lost acquisition response triggers reconciliation before another allocation.
Unresolved allocations and failed validation remain visible until cleanup completes.

title: Implement lease renewal and allocation cleanup
details: Persist lease state and retry idempotent release through visible cleanup obligations.
acceptance_criteria: Expired attachments reject operations and report provider termination separately.
Renewal failures mark resources unavailable when authority expires.
Cleanup survives restart and cannot invalidate unrelated attachments.

title: Implement content-addressed blob storage
details: Store and retrieve durable SHA-256 blobs with integrity and size checks.
acceptance_criteria: Corrupt or incomplete blobs cannot be published in revisions.
Binary data round-trips and duplicate content shares a digest.
Authorized retrieval and transfer limits apply before publication.

title: Implement canonical workspace trees and paths
details: Build sorted tree manifests with the exact hash encoding and portable metadata rules.
acceptance_criteria: Digest vectors cover Unicode sequences, executable bits, directories, and binary files.
Absolute paths, traversal, null bytes, unsupported links, and special files fail explicitly.
Target path collisions and unrepresentable names are rejected without renaming.

title: Implement stable workspace import and checkpoints
details: Create immutable revisions from locked or snapshotted sources with recorded import exclusions.
acceptance_criteria: Initial import creates a revision; later imports require the expected head.
Uncoordinated writers without a snapshot cause WorkspaceUnstable.
File counts, byte limits, and exclusion provenance are enforced.

title: Implement materialization and private working copies
details: Transfer selected revisions into read-only snapshots or isolated mutable copies.
acceptance_criteria: Transfer policy is checked before bytes leave the source.
Materialization verifies all hashes and target filesystem compatibility.
Private copies cannot publish directly to the authoritative head.

title: Implement workspace proposals and acceptance
details: Create candidate revisions and accept them through an atomic expected-head check.
acceptance_criteria: Concurrent proposals cannot overwrite each other silently.
A stale head returns WorkspaceConflict without mutation or automatic merging.
Acceptance rejects proposals from stale attachment generations.

title: Implement local export and crash recovery
details: Stage accepted changes, validate the local base tree, and journal export recovery.
acceptance_criteria: Changed local files cause a conflict before overwrite.
An exclusive bridge lock protects export and recovery.
Crashes between file updates can complete or restore before another bridge operation.

title: Implement the workspace capability
details: Expose list, read, write, delete, and stat against authorized working copies.
acceptance_criteria: Read-only copies reject mutation and paths are validated on every call.
Writes are atomic per file and binary transfer is explicit.
Capability operations cannot change revision authority directly.

title: Implement invocation admission and request deduplication
details: Atomically admit operations and persist request keys and input hashes before dispatch.
acceptance_criteria: Admission checks session, attachment, generation, policy, and lease together.
A repeated key returns the existing operation; changed input returns RequestConflict.
Admission races with replacement and release cannot dispatch stale work.

title: Implement operation outcomes and reconciliation
details: Persist dispatch, completion, failure, and uncertainty without unsafe replay.
acceptance_criteria: A lost response after possible effects becomes unknown.
Reconciliation appends evidence and preserves the original unknown record.
Nonzero process exit codes remain completed operations; unsafe effects are not retried automatically.

title: Implement cancellation and deadlines
details: Apply deadlines and represent confirmed, best-effort, and unsupported cancellation.
acceptance_criteria: Timeout alone never proves termination.
Cancelling a caller wait leaves the remote operation running unless explicitly cancelled.
Prior effects remain visible after cancellation and unconfirmed stops remain unresolved.

title: Implement streamed output and artifact records
details: Persist ordered output streams and content-addressed result artifacts.
acceptance_criteria: Standard output and standard error remain separate with per-stream sequence numbers.
Binary output, truncation, omitted byte counts when known, and continued execution are reported.
Artifact records contain digest, size, media type, and authorized retrieval information.

title: Implement resource binding and validity checks
details: Track ownership, generation, lifetime, expiry, and authorized bindings.
acceptance_criteria: Stale, expired, unauthorized, and released resources fail resolution.
Reattachment creates a new binding without reviving old handles.
Provider credentials never appear in portable references.

title: Implement the native process capability contract
details: Define validated run, start, inspect, and terminate requests and results.
acceptance_criteria: Arguments, working directory, environment, input, timeout, and output limits have explicit semantics.
Signals, descendant termination, and process lifetime are declared attributes.
Shell interpretation occurs only through an explicitly requested shell executable.

title: Implement the local process adapter
details: Execute managed local processes and report actual host access and enforcement.
acceptance_criteria: All required process operations work with binary input and separate output streams.
Background resources remain inspectable across CLI exits through a documented supervisor or equivalent mechanism.
Unsupported isolation is rejected and termination claims are tested against descendants.

title: Implement verification provenance
details: Associate executions with actual inputs, working copies, manifests, and dependency identifiers.
acceptance_criteria: Verification excludes unrelated writers and records input and output tree hashes.
Modified working copies are never reported as testing the unchanged base revision.
Results report tracked input changes, arguments, adapter version, and available image or dependency identifiers.

title: Implement policy revocation
details: Commit updated authority and stop further admissions under revoked permissions.
acceptance_criteria: New admissions reject revoked authority immediately after commit.
Existing operations receive supported cancellation requests.
Unconfirmed cancellation remains visible rather than being reported as stopped.

title: Implement release and session reopening
details: Release attachments and reopen or close sessions with reconciled resource state.
acceptance_criteria: Closing rejects new work and stays closing until release succeeds or unresolved allocations are recorded.
Repeated release is idempotent and invalidates owned handles.
Reopening reconciles leases and operations without pretending to restore a harness conversation.

title: Define the lightweight Python capability
details: Define evaluation schemas, engine attributes, language subsets, limits, and host-function bindings.
acceptance_criteria: Matching distinguishes lightweight execution from full Python semantics.
Input and result serialization, output, and structured exceptions are specified.
Interpreter locals are not declared portable workspace state.

title: Implement the lightweight Python adapter
details: Select and integrate a lightweight engine, starting with Monty if it satisfies the required profile.
acceptance_criteria: Document the selected engine version, subset, imports, limits, and unsupported requirements.
Isolated evaluation works with authorized workspace and host functions.
Conformance cases cover unsupported imports, serialization, limits, and state isolation.

title: Select remote compute and browser providers
details: Evaluate provider contracts and select one remote Linux provider and one independent browser provider.
acceptance_criteria: Record acquisition reconciliation, persistence, enforcement, and service connectivity support from provider documentation.
Document credentials, test authority, cleanup behavior, and unsupported requirements.
Selected providers can satisfy the acceptance workflow without adding an MCP dependency.

title: Implement remote Linux allocation and leases
details: Implement remote discovery, acquisition, reconciliation, renewal, and release.
acceptance_criteria: Lost acquisition responses are recoverable by durable identity.
Acquired manifests describe actual resources and supported enforcement.
Paid tests require configured authority; leaked or uncertain allocations remain visible.

title: Implement remote processes and workspace transfer
details: Run native commands and manage private copies on the selected remote provider.
acceptance_criteria: Arguments, binary output, timeouts, background processes, and termination semantics satisfy the declared profile.
Transfers validate policy and hashes before use.
Changes return as proposals with provenance instead of overwriting local files.

title: Implement reconstruction recipes and state classification
details: Validate state dispositions and run declared reconstruction through authorized operations.
acceptance_criteria: Recipes declare revision, capabilities, operations, outputs, and failure conditions.
Portable, reconstructable, reattachable, and native state receive explicit treatment.
Native state is invalidated and parsing a recipe never executes it.

title: Implement replacement planning
details: Build a side-effect-free plan for replacing one attachment.
acceptance_criteria: Plans list preserved, reconstructed, reattached, and invalidated state.
Stale source generations and unsatisfied required resources fail before provisioning.
Planning allocates nothing and does not change the workspace head.

title: Implement replacement preparation and checkpointing
details: Quiesce the source, block admissions, and persist the selected revision and transition inventory.
acceptance_criteria: Wait, cancel, and reject policies handle active operations explicitly.
Unknown outcomes block replacement; deadlines cannot bypass them.
Managed background writers stop or use a declared consistent snapshot before checkpointing.

title: Implement replacement destination preparation
details: Provision, materialize, reconstruct, bind resources, and validate the candidate environment.
acceptance_criteria: Acquisition uses the transition request identity and reconciles interrupted requests.
Validation checks manifest, enforcement, revision integrity, and required resources.
Source authority remains unchanged until the switch transaction.

title: Implement the atomic attachment switch
details: Commit the new binding, generation, resources, event, outcome, and cleanup obligations together.
acceptance_criteria: The transaction validates generation, fencing token, and candidate validation state.
Unrelated attachment generations and the workspace head remain unchanged.
A repeated request after a lost switch response returns the committed result.

title: Implement replacement abort and forward recovery
details: Resume or abort durable transitions and preserve the committed authority boundary.
acceptance_criteria: Failures before switch retain the source binding and clean up candidates.
Failures after switch never reactivate the old generation; source cleanup retries independently.
Failure reports list surviving reconstruction effects and any source services that need rebuilding.

title: Define browser and service capability contracts
details: Specify browser lifecycle and service exposure schemas with owner generations and audiences.
acceptance_criteria: Browser create, navigate, screenshot, inspect, and close are fully typed.
Service expose, connect, and close specify process, port, protocol, audience, and expiration.
Independent browser lifetimes and dependent service bindings have distinct validity rules.

title: Implement the independent browser adapter
details: Create and operate browser sessions independently of compute allocation.
acceptance_criteria: Sessions support the selected persistence and reattachment behavior.
Screenshots become authorized artifacts and provider expiration is reported.
Cookies stay provider-owned and releasing compute does not close the browser.

title: Implement authorized service connections
details: Expose application ports and bind an authorized browser consumer to the service.
acceptance_criteria: Exposure and consumer egress policy are checked independently.
Public unauthenticated exposure requires explicit authority.
Compute replacement invalidates old connections while preserving the browser session.

title: Integrate browser continuity with compute replacement
details: Reconstruct the application server and create a new service binding after compute replacement.
acceptance_criteria: The same valid browser handle connects to the replacement server.
Old compute and service handles fail without affecting the browser generation.
Expired browser leases are reported honestly instead of claiming preservation.

title: Implement bundle export
details: Export validated workspace state, journal entries, resource references, and state dispositions.
acceptance_criteria: Self-contained bundles include every referenced blob; reference-only bundles identify authorized locations.
Manifests include schema, revision, root hash, generations, inventory, and dispositions.
Secrets and reusable credentials are absent and opaque harness references remain opaque.

title: Implement bundle validation and import
details: Validate bundles before creating a new session and materializing approved state.
acceptance_criteria: Reject missing or corrupt blobs, unsafe paths, size violations, and unknown required extensions.
Import does not execute recipes or claim authority over the source session.
Same-session continuation requires the original authoritative control store and its locks.

title: Assemble the public library interface
details: Expose the complete Portable and Session interfaces with validated serializable results.
acceptance_criteria: Every specified method is available and documented with concrete supporting types.
Long operations expose durable identifiers before completion without implicit cancellation on wait exit.
Adapter-specific behavior stays behind declared capability contracts.

title: Implement CLI configuration and output conventions
details: Build the thin CLI with explicit session selection, request files, standard input, and structured output.
acceptance_criteria: Machine output is JSON or newline-delimited JSON; diagnostics use standard error.
Exit codes distinguish known failure, invalid input, and unknown outcome.
Secrets and JSON requests do not require shell interpolation; multiple sessions are never guessed.

title: Implement CLI session and workspace commands
details: Expose session creation, description, checkpoints, proposals, and acceptance.
acceptance_criteria: Commands call library methods and validate expected revisions and generations.
Conflicts leave existing files and authoritative state unchanged.
Documented examples run against a temporary local workspace.

title: Implement CLI attachment and operation commands
details: Expose attach, invoke, operation inspection, cancellation, and release.
acceptance_criteria: Request keys and generations reach the library without being regenerated on retries.
Completed process failures retain their process exit code in the result.
Long operations return identifiers and remain inspectable across CLI process exits.

title: Implement CLI replacement, recovery, and events
details: Expose replacement plans, execution, durable recovery, and event replay.
acceptance_criteria: Plan mode makes no allocations and reports state dispositions.
Recovery reports unresolved operations and pending allocation cleanup.
Event output resumes by sequence and replacement results report old and new generations.

title: Implement the reusable conformance runner
details: Load adapters and execute capability profiles with machine-readable reports.
acceptance_criteria: Reports identify spec, adapter, provider configuration, passed cases, failed cases, and skipped cases.
Skipped cases never count as supported behavior.
External effects and paid allocation require configured test authority.

title: Add acquisition and policy conformance cases
details: Test acquisition reconciliation, lease behavior, matching, and authorization.
acceptance_criteria: Cover duplicate acquisition, lost response, release retry, expiration, and stale controllers.
Cover missing capability, insufficient resources, unknown constraints, ambiguous provider, and policy denial.
Verify declared restrictions using observable behavior and report their enforcement limits.

title: Add workspace conformance cases
details: Verify tree integrity, portable files, proposal authority, stable checkpoints, and export recovery.
acceptance_criteria: Cover binary files, Unicode, executable bits, invalid paths, links, size limits, and hash mismatch.
Race proposals and local edits to verify conflict behavior.
Inject interruptions during export and confirm recovery before subsequent bridge operations.

title: Add process and operation conformance cases
details: Exercise declared process behavior and operation uncertainty against local and remote adapters.
acceptance_criteria: Cover arguments, directory, environment, binary output, exit codes, limits, timeout, and descendants.
Cover duplicate keys, mismatched inputs, lost responses after effects, and unconfirmed cancellation.
Verify reconciliation preserves uncertainty history without duplicate unsafe execution.

title: Add lightweight Python conformance cases
details: Verify the selected engine against its advertised evaluation subset.
acceptance_criteria: Cover supported syntax, unsupported imports, host-function limits, serialization, and structured exceptions.
Independent calls cannot accidentally depend on prior interpreter locals.
Unsupported full-Python requirements fail matching explicitly.

title: Add replacement failure and resource conformance cases
details: Inject failures across all replacement phases and verify attachment and resource authority.
acceptance_criteria: Crash immediately before and after switch; race expired controllers and duplicate requests.
Cover failed candidate validation, failed cleanup, unavailable destination, and unknown operations.
Verify browser survival, browser expiry, stale handles, and invalidated service connections.

title: Add event and bundle conformance cases
details: Verify durable event delivery and portable bundle integrity boundaries.
acceptance_criteria: Restart and replay events without missing committed state; tolerate duplicate delivery.
Reject missing blobs, tampering, unsupported required extensions, and unauthorized references.
Import creates no competing controller and executes no reconstruction recipe.

title: Expose conformance through the CLI
details: Wire the conformance command to adapter loading, profile selection, and report output.
acceptance_criteria: The documented command runs a selected profile against a configured adapter.
Failures and skips remain distinct in machine output and command exit status.
Paid profiles do not run without configured test authority.

title: Document and implement one harness integration
details: Select one existing coding harness and supply a wrapper or instructions for managed Portable execution.
acceptance_criteria: Define the local bridge, file authority, and route for built-in shell and file tools.
Translate trusted approvals into bounded runtime authority; surface environment changes to the agent.
Demonstrate session reopening while stating the limits of harness conversation restoration.

title: Create the executable acceptance fixture
details: Add a small repository fixture with data inspection, native tests, and a browser-visible application.
acceptance_criteria: The fixture needs lightweight evaluation, native processes, and independent browser inspection for concrete reasons.
Dependency reconstruction and application startup use declared recipes.
Artifacts identify their workspace revision and can be checked by the acceptance driver.

title: Run and automate the full acceptance demonstration
details: Execute the complete scale, compose, replace, recover, release, and reopen workflow.
acceptance_criteria: All seven specification steps produce retained evidence and resource status.
Injected failure proves one authority, stale handle rejection, and no unsafe retry of unknown effects.
A local edit after verification produces a conflict and results retain the earlier tested revision.

title: Complete release documentation and coverage review
details: Document setup, schemas, providers, lifecycle behavior, and conformance evidence; review every first-release requirement.
acceptance_criteria: Map all normative first-release requirements to implementation and validation evidence.
README examples match implemented library-first behavior and describe unresolved provider limitations.
The documented clean-checkout build, local conformance suite, and authorized acceptance workflow pass.
